g.text: reads the evals once, and on Reload
holds which card's ask is open
shows the key box on a refused key
reads the run once, and every 3 s while it goes
asks the run for every figure
the first failed repeat and its miss

text.tspan: The pages read through the client, which reads the routes the addresses name; each eval is a card, each conversation of a run a row, and the words come from one place.
